description: Animates city-roads' synthetic underground layer: watches the published road_network for underground (layer="underground") edges, groups them by transport_mode/name, and spawns one shuttle entity per line/tunnel found, ping-ponging it back and forth along that line's own node sequence forever. Publishes the same kind/agent_type shape agent-behavior-test's own vehicle agents use, plus a new vehicle_kind ("subway_wagon"/"car") rendering-test-ui uses to pick a real subway-wagon/car silhouette. Has no idea how many underground lines exist or where -- discovers everything purely from the published attribute, same as every other watch/write plugin here.
author: prackoreal
